$comment: Edition metadata and the honesty stamps. build.js reads this and REFUSES to build if the
invariants below are violated. See scripts/lib/meta.js for the checks.
THE TWO DATES ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE AND MUST NOT BE COLLAPSED INTO ONE.
lastReviewedByHuman - the date the named reviewer last signed off on this section/document.
lastUpdatedByAI     - the date the text last changed, whether or not it has been reviewed.
Raj explicitly allowed AI updates to land AFTER his review (2026-08-25), so these two dates
diverging is the NORMAL state, not an error. When lastUpdatedByAI > lastReviewedByHuman the
page must say so IN WORDS above the fold. build.js generates that banner automatically so it
cannot be forgotten - do not replace it with two dates in a footer.
